correctness.rationale: For the printed Poulton–Ellner ODE, at the admitted p=v=0 endpoint A'=-q(t)A with q=beta*alpha(P)*P+w+mu+c(P)>=mu>0. Thus every interior A(0)>0 satisfies 0<A(t)<=A(0)exp(-mu*t)->0 even for R0>1, disproving *full four-variable* uniform persistence. The hyperface A=0 is invariant, and for R0=beta*theta/[lambda*(gamma+mu+phi)]>1 it contains (S,A,I,P)=(1/R0,0,mu*(1-1/R0)/(mu+phi),theta*I/lambda), not disease free. Direct rational substitution with mu=gamma=theta=lambda=1,beta=4,phi=w=p=v=0 gives R0=2 and (1/2,0,1/2,1/2). The essential failure in the primary supplementary S1.5 is the assertion p*gamma*I+v*S>0 at A=0. No claim is made about loss of persistence of I and P.
